text: 14h Founders, remember when you first told your family you were starting up? There were probably a lot of questions. “Job kyun chhod rahe ho?” “What about your savings?” “Bechega kya?” It’s a moment every founder remembers. And perhaps one their families do too. Because for them, it’s someone they love taking a leap into the unknown. And sometimes, what sounds like worry is simply care. After all, before you win the boardroom, you have to win the living room. So, if there’s a startup you’ve been dreaming about, the festive season might just be the perfect time to have that conversation because the people who matter are finally in the same room! Iss Diwali, apne #StartupKaBombPhodo! 💥 From us and ours, to you and yours, Happy Diwali! 💙 Yash Bhanage | Bombay Sweet Shop #StartupKaBombPhodo #Razorpay …more 1,035 32 Comments Like Comment Share Prahlad Yadav 2h The best part is how familiar the family reactions feel.
